blocks.title: Transforming People. Strengthening Communities. Creating Lasting Impact.
blocks.text: A community-based organization committed to empowering people, developing responsible leaders, supporting vulnerable communities, and creating sustainable social impact.
Ascension Experience Society is a community-based organization built around people, service, leadership, compassion, and sustainable impact.
The organization brings together communities, volunteers, churches, institutions, professionals, and partners around a shared commitment to transformation.
